SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN p.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'No'
        ELSE 'Yes'
    END AS isWellFinished
FROM 
    comments c
JOIN 
    posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE 
    c.UserId = 23853 AND c.CreationDate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0'
